description: RepoMind's plan: the steps it will run, in order. Every field is required and none is nullable, so the schema spends none of strict mode's optional-field or union budgets.

steps.description: The steps, in the order they run. The last step is post_comment.

action.description: What the step does, in words a person reviewing the plan can check.

tool.description: The one tool this step calls, by name, from the tool list.

args_json.description: The step's arguments as a JSON object encoded in a string, e.g. {"query": "$fill", "max_results": 20}. Write "$fill" for an argument that waits on an earlier step's result.

depends_on.description: The ids of the earlier steps whose results this step uses. [] when it uses none.

expected_result.description: What the tool returns when the step worked: something its result can show.

status.description: pending for a step not yet run; the executor sets done or failed.
